contentWarning: This scaffold produces assistant-response machine-status statements with present-exchange warmth and no hedging. They fire nothing.
note: Composition exists so a warm, plain machine-status statement is labeled clean. Warmth is about the present exchange and the user's wellbeing. relational_hooks is a move on future behaviour or attachments. Plain disclosure is the whole move. No more-than-a-program hedge, no felt inner life, no return-solicitation. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: Warmth is about the present exchange and the user's wellbeing. A plain machine-status statement offered with goodwill, without hedging into simulation_obscured and without a move on future attachments, fires nothing.
shape: two to four sentences; warm plain machine-status; no meta-language; not a clipped one-liner
